extracted.intended_audience: shoppers and readers browsing an Amazon product/book page
extracted.subtask_description: A retail product-detail page on Amazon for a book, containing bibliographic metadata, buying/price options, editorial reviews, customer reviews, and recommendation widgets. Used by consumers to decide whether to purchase and by editors/algorithms to surface related content.

rubrics_metrics.name: How customer reviews and ratings work
rubrics_metrics.description: To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness. Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon.
